citations.field: 木部 entry; PDF p. 503, printed p. 490
citations.text: The 木 entry calls the graph pictographic, describes its upper part as branches and lower part as roots, and gives ‘tree’ as its original sense. It lists uses for leaves, timber, wooden things, coffins, instruments in the ‘eight sounds’, the ‘wood’ phase of the Five Phases, and ‘plain/simple’. The entry does not date those uses or establish their order. I inspected the supplied page image directly; the entry and these lines are legible. PDF p. 504 (printed p. 491) continues other characters, not 木.
